title: Tropical Open Strings in a Kalb-Ramond Background
summary: We study tropical open strings arising from the analytically continued action of tropological sigma models in the presence of a constant Kalb-Ramond background. We show that the background field separates the theory into a generic sector and a critical sector. In the generic sector, the canonical structure produces a kinematical nonlocal bracket between the transverse and leafwise target-space coordinates.
